<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920487_theRebbe_9" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920487_theRebbe_9__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that within the concept of "My Face," there are two levels in each of the three aspects: an inner aspect related to the external, and a true inner aspect separate from the external, corresponding to Atzilus and above Atzilus, and similarly within the heart's pnimiyus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, regarding the matter of "My Face,"</t>
    <t s="2">in each of these three aspects,</t>
    <t s="3">there are two levels,</t>
    <t s="4">generally.</t>
    <t s="5">An inner aspect that has a connection to the external,</t>
    <t s="6">and a true inner aspect that is separate from the external.</t>
    <t s="7">For in the matter of the worlds, it is Atzilus and above Atzilus.</t>
    <t s="8">And as the Tzemach Tzedek wrote</t>
    <t s="9">in explaining the verse, "Seek My face; Your face, Hashem, I will seek,"</t>
    <t s="10">that "Seek My face" is to draw down Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="11">Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="12">and "Your face, Hashem, I will seek" is to draw down the face of Hashem,</t>
    <t s="13">the lights of Arich and Atik.</t>
    <t s="14">For the distinction between Atzilus and above Atzilus is,</t>
    <t s="15">that Atzilus is included in the four worlds, except that it is their "face,"</t>
    <t s="16">an inner aspect that relates to the external,</t>
    <t s="17">and above Atzilus is above the worlds,</t>
    <t s="18">an inner aspect that is separate from the external.</t>
    <t s="19">And similarly, in the pnimiyus of the heart,</t>
    <t s="20">the face of the souls,</t>
    <t s="21">there is a parallel to these two levels.</t>
    <t s="22">And as explained in Likkutei Torah, the discourse "Ki Seitzei Lamilchamah Al Oivecha,"</t>
    <t s="23">that in the pnimiyus of the heart there are two levels,</t>
    <t s="24">the illumination of the point of the heart and the essence of the point of the heart,</t>
    <t s="25">that both levels are from Atzilus</t>
    <t s="26">[for this is the distinction between the external heart and the inner heart,</t>
    <t s="27">that the external heart is from Biyah and the inner heart is from Atzilus.</t>
    <t s="28">And this is that the external heart is based on reason and intellect, and the inner heart is above reason and intellect,</t>
    <t s="29">for in Beriah there is the matter of comprehension,</t>
    <t s="30">"Ima nests in Kisei,"</t>
    <t s="31">and Atzilus in general is Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="32">for the true essence of Chochmah is above intellect],</t>
    <t s="33">except that the illumination of the point of the heart is from the Atzilus that is within the pnimiyus of Biyah, and the essence of the point of the heart is from Atzilus itself.</t>
    <t s="34">And as above,</t>
    <t s="35">the aspect of Atzilus that is in Biyah is only the illumination of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="36">so too in the soul of man,</t>
    <t s="37">this aspect is only the illumination of the point of the heart.</t>
    <t s="38">Thus,</t>
    <t s="39">the illumination of the point of the heart is what shines from the pnimiyus of the heart to the external heart</t>
    <t s="40">(like the illumination of Atzilus in Biyah),</t>
    <t s="41">and the essence of the point of the heart is the pnimiyus as it is in its place.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that similarly in the pnimiyus of Elokus there are two levels, corresponding to the names Havayah and Elokim, where Havayah is pnimiyus and Elokim is chitzoniyus, and "Face of Havayah" refers to the essence of Havayah above its investment in Elokim.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And similarly, in the pnimiyus of Elokus,</t>
    <t s="1">there is a parallel to the two levels mentioned above.</t>
    <t s="2">And this will be understood based on what is stated in Tanya</t>
    <t s="3">regarding the two names Havayah and Elokim,</t>
    <t s="4">that Elokim is chitzoniyus and Havayah is pnimiyus.</t>
    <t s="5">[And one can connect this with what is explained in Likkutei Torah there,</t>
    <t s="6">that the love in the external heart comes through contemplation of the Or HaMimaleh,</t>
    <t s="7">and the love</t>
    <t s="8">(desire and will that is above reason and intellect)</t>
    <t s="9">that is in the pnimiyus of the heart is drawn from the Or HaSovev,</t>
    <t s="10">for Havayah and Elokim are</t>
    <t s="11">(generally)</t>
    <t s="12">Sovev and Mimaleh.</t>
    <t s="13">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="14">the Or HaMimaleh</t>
    <t s="15">(Elokim),</t>
    <t s="16">chitzoniyus,</t>
    <t s="17">is the root of the love of the external heart,</t>
    <t s="18">and the Or HaSovev</t>
    <t s="19">(Havayah),</t>
    <t s="20">pnimiyus,</t>
    <t s="21">is the root of the love of the pnimiyus of the heart].</t>
    <t s="22">And based on this, it can be said,</t>
    <t s="23">that the meaning of "Your face, Havayah" is the essence of Havayah that is above its investment in Elokim.</t>
    <t s="24">For that Havayah</t>
    <t s="25">(in general)</t>
    <t s="26">is pnimiyus,</t>
    <t s="27">is even after it invests in Elokim.</t>
    <t s="28">And "Your face, Havayah" is the essence of Havayah that is above its investment in Elokim.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the aspect of "Face of Havayah" is above even Havayah that is above investment in Elokim, for the true pnimiyus is the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above the name Havayah, as the name Havayah still relates to bringing into being.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said that the aspect of "Your face, Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="2">the pnimiyus of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="3">is above even Havayah that is above investment in Elokim.</t>
    <t s="4">[And like the explanation elsewhere</t>
    <t s="5">on the verse,</t>
    <t s="6">"And the truth of Havayah is forever,"</t>
    <t s="7">that even the name Havayah that is above investment in Elokim is Havayah</t>
    <t s="8">(simple),</t>
    <t s="9">and "the truth of Havayah"</t>
    <t s="10">(the true [essence] of Havayah)</t>
    <t s="11">is the Essence of Ein Sof that is above the name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="12">above even Havayah that is above investment in Elokim].</t>
    <t s="13">And this will be understood based on the known principle</t>
    <t s="14">that the pnimiyus of any thing is the thing itself,</t>
    <t s="15">and that it is a source for some other matter,</t>
    <t s="16">that is its chitzoniyus.</t>
    <t s="17">And based on this, we can explain the distinction between the two levels in the pnimiyus above</t>
    <t s="18">(Havayah and Ein Sof that is above Havayah),</t>
    <t s="19">that Havayah is a term of bringing into being,</t>
    <t s="20">except that the coming into being from the name Havayah is in a manner of "by way of automatic consequence."</t>
    <t s="21">And as is known</t>
    <t s="22">that the coming into being from the name Elokim is in a manner of investment</t>
    <t s="23">("In the beginning, Elokim created"),</t>
    <t s="24">and the coming into being from the name Havayah is in a manner of "by way of automatic consequence"</t>
    <t s="25">("They will praise the name of Havayah, for He commanded and they were created").</t>
    <t s="26">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="27">generally,</t>
    <t s="28">the name Havayah is pnimiyus,</t>
    <t s="29">for that the coming into being from it is in a manner of "by way of automatic consequence,"</t>
    <t s="30">indicates that it is wondrously separate from the matter of coming into being</t>
    <t s="31">(and is not a true source).</t>
    <t s="32">But in particular,</t>
    <t s="33">that from the name Havayah coming into being occurs,</t>
    <t s="34">is because it is a source for coming into being,</t>
    <t s="35">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="36">the essential matter of pnimiyus is in the Essence of Ein Sof that is above Havayah.</t>
  </section>
